pairs: These are the generations of the sons of Noah:
natique sunt eis filii post diluvium.
and of the sons who were born to them after the great flood.
The sons of Japheth were Gomer,
Porro filii Gomer: Ascenez et Riphath et Thogorma.
And then the sons of Gomer were Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
Filii autem Javan: Elisa et Tharsis,
And the sons of Javan were Elishah, and Tarshish,
Ab his divisæ sunt insulæ gentium in regionibus suis,
The islands of the Gentiles were divided by these into their regions,
each one according to his tongue,
et familias suas in nationibus suis.
and their families in their nations.
And the Sons of Ham were Cush,
And the sons of Cush were Seba,
The sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dadan.
ipse cœpit esse potens in terra,
he began to be powerful on the earth.
et erat robustus venator coram Domino.
And he was an able hunter before the Lord.
From this, a proverb came forth:
Quasi Nemrod robustus venator coram Domino.
‘Just like Nimrod, an able hunter before the Lord.’
Fuit autem principium regni ejus Babylon,
And so, the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon,
De terra illa egressus est Assur,
From that land, Assur came forth,
and the streets of the city,
de quibus egressi sunt Philisthiim et Caphtorim.
from whom came forth the Philistines and the Caphtorim.
Chanaan autem genuit Sidonem primogenitum suum.
Then Canaan conceived Sidon his firstborn,
et post hæc disseminati sunt populi Chananæorum.
And after this, the peoples of the Canaanites became widespread.
Factique sunt termini Chanaan venientibus a Sidone Geraram usque Gazam,
And the borders of Canaan went, as one travels, from Sidon to Gerar,
even to Gaza, until one enters Sodom and Gomorrah,
et Adamam, et Seboim usque Lesa.
and from Admah and Zeboiim, even to Lesa.
Hi sunt filii Cham in cognationibus,
These are the sons of Ham in their kindred,
the father of all the sons of Heber,
the elder brother of Japheth, sons were born.
The sons of Shem were Elam,
The sons of Aram were Uz,
And to Eber were born two sons:
the name of the one was Peleg,
eo quod in diebus ejus divisa sit terra:
for in his days the earth became divided,
and his brother’s name was Joktan.
All these were the sons of Joktan.
Et facta est habitatio eorum de Messa pergentibus usque Sephar montem orientalem.
And their habitation extended from Messa, as one sojourns, even to Sephar, a mountain in the east.
These are the sons of Shem according to their kindred,
and the regions within their nations.
Hæ familiæ Noë juxta populos et nationes suas.
These are the families of Noah, according to their peoples and nations.
Ab his divisæ sunt gentes in terra post diluvium.
The nations became divided according to these, on the earth after the great flood.
